description: Put back the previous versions the last deploy set aside on the server: overwritten files are restored, files it added are removed, files it deleted come back. Needs no git. Use dryRun to see what it would do. The coolFTP app asks the user to approve when it is open.

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the COOLFTP_PROJECT setting, else the MCP server working directory.

dryRun.description: Report what would be restored and removed without changing the server

site.description: Site name. Defaults to the site in the nearest .coolftp.json, or the only saved site.

to.description: Deploy id from coolftp_history to undo instead of the latest (only if no later deploy touched its files)

name: coolftp_undo
